doc: The only target vocabulary holon sorts reads (I13), frozen in the I13 preregistration before the solver first ran on the Morph facts. Lexical seeds match real-code text only: a state field's or record field's doc (doc_fields), a constant's constants_doc, and library builtin / facts def names. They never match a fact variable's own name, a law id, or a ghost field (ghost_state, a record's ghost fields and their docs are not read). Every seed is a unit constraint listing the rule ids that ground it. Writer labels name writer sets (whitepaper §7.3); they are names only: whether two registers get distinct refined sorts is decided by the solver's rules, not by this file.

writer_labels.fallback: when not every writer of the set matches one rule's prefix: 'w' followed by the first 8 hex digits of sha256 of the sorted writer names joined by ','
